create_aiohttp_handler: create a BaseLLMAIOHTTPHandler instance with optional aiohttp client session, transport, and connector
build_async_completion: build an async LLM completion call using BaseLLMAIOHTTPHandler.async_completion with provider config and model response
build_sync_completion: build a sync LLM completion call using BaseLLMAIOHTTPHandler.completion with messages, model, and timeout parameters
run_async_image_variations: run async image variation requests using BaseLLMAIOHTTPHandler.async_image_variations with file data and provider config
